content.rendered:
SAMAN Portable manufactures porta cabins in Ludhiana as a direct factory, not a marketplace reseller. We have built modular steel cabins — porta cabins, also called portable cabins — since 2009, and completed 500+ projects across India. Units for Ludhiana are fabricated at our Greater Noida works and sent by road to sites across the city, the Focal Point industrial estate, and the Dhandari Kalan belt. At about 320–350 km, most Ludhiana orders reach the site in 3–4 days once the build is ready.

A porta cabin is a factory-built steel cabin that arrives finished and ready to use. It gives you a clean, lockable, weather-proof room without the time, cost, and mess of on-site civil construction. For one of India's densest manufacturing cities — bicycle and auto-parts units, hosiery and textiles, machine tools, and fasteners and hand tools across Focal Point and the Gill Road belt — a porta cabin is the fastest way to put a site office, staff room, or security post exactly where the work is.

How we build our porta cabins

Every unit starts with a mild steel frame in IS 2062 structural steel, welded and treated to resist rust through Ludhiana's hot summers and cold, foggy Punjab winters. The base sits on a channel frame so the cabin stays off wet or dusty ground. Walls use insulated PUF sandwich panels, or cement board with rockwool, so the inside stays comfortable in both the peak heat and the January cold. The roof is profiled GI sheet with a slope for rain runoff. Flooring is marine ply with vinyl for office use, or chequered MS plate for heavy gate and store cabins on busy factory yards. A standard fit-out covers electrical wiring with switches, points, LED lights and an MCB distribution board, powder-coated windows with grille and shutter, and a steel or laminated door with a lock. We add air-conditioning, toilets with plumbing, pantry units, and internal partitions when a site needs them.

Common porta cabin sizes for Ludhiana sites

Popular configurations are 10×8 ft and 10×10 ft for a single supervisor, guard, or weighbridge cabin, 20×8 ft (the standard shipping-container footprint) for a site office that seats a small team, and 40×8 ft for larger project offices with two or three rooms. We also fabricate to custom dimensions, and stack units in double-decker form where ground space is tight — a common request on packed Focal Point and Dhandari Kalan plots. If you are unsure of the size, tell us the headcount and how the cabin will be used and we will suggest a layout that fits your plot.

Where porta cabins are used around Ludhiana

Buyers in the Ludhiana region use our porta cabins as admin and supervisor offices inside bicycle, auto-parts, and machine-tool units across the Focal Point industrial estate (141010), staff and store cabins for hosiery and textile plants in the Dhandari Kalan belt (141014), gate and security cabins for factories and warehouses on the Gill Road corridor, weighbridge and billing cabins for logistics yards, and portable offices for the many small engineering units across the city (141001). For teams setting up on raw ground, we build hardened site-office porta cabins with heavier flooring and extra power points for tools and equipment.

Customization and price factors

Because every unit is made to order, the porta cabin price in Ludhiana depends on the size, the panel type (PUF costs more than cement board but insulates far better through the Punjab winters), the flooring, and add-ons like air-conditioning, a toilet, a pantry, or extra electrical load for machines. Colour, branding, window and door count, and internal partitions are all your choice. We confirm the final quote after a short requirement discussion rather than showing a fixed sticker price that would not match your actual build — so you pay for the cabin you need, not a template. Compare our specifications against any marketplace listing: the difference is that you are dealing with the factory that welds the frame, not an agent forwarding your enquiry to someone else.

Delivery, warranty, and certifications

Delivery to Ludhiana is charged at ₹3,000 where applicable, with road transit of about 3–4 days once the unit is ready. We also offer a 7-day return window, with return shipping paid by the customer. SAMAN Portable operates under ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and is registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our porta cabins carry a 5-year structural frame and base warranty, 1–2 years on finishing, and a 20–25 year engineered service life for the steel structure — real, verifiable credentials that a marketplace listing cannot show you.

Why buy your porta cabin from SAMAN

Search for a porta cabin on a directory and you get a page of resellers competing on the same stock photos. Enquire with SAMAN and you reach the manufacturer directly — honest specifications, real size options, transparent price factors, and one point of accountability from fabrication to dispatch. See how we run porta cabin production for Ludhiana factories, look at our container offices we build for Ludhiana sites, and our work across the northern belt — porta cabins supplied around Chandigarh, cabins we deliver into Panipat, and porta cabin projects reaching Jaipur — shows the same build quality reaches every site in the region.

Why Ludhiana factories choose a porta cabin over on-site building

In a city that runs on tight production schedules, waiting weeks for a mason to build a site office is lost time. A porta cabin is fabricated at our works while your site keeps running, then delivered ready to use — power points, windows, door, and lock already fitted. For Focal Point and Dhandari Kalan units, that means a supervisor cabin or gate post standing the same week, not the same month. Because it is bolted steel, not brick, it can be relocated as your plant layout changes or moved to a new unit entirely. And the quote is fixed to the specification you approve, so there is no creeping civil cost. For most Ludhiana buyers, the deciding factors are speed, a firm price, and the freedom to move the cabin later.

For Ludhiana factories, the best specification starts with the working use. A gate cabin needs sight lines, a counter window, durable flooring, and easy locking; an admin or dispatch cabin needs desk space, plug points, insulation, and sometimes a small record-storage partition. Focal Point and Dhandari Kalan sites also vary in access, so tell us the lane width, gate height, crane or hydra availability, and whether the cabin will sit on a paved yard or compacted ground. With those details we can recommend a 10×8 ft, 20×8 ft, or custom unit, choose the right panel and electrical load, and keep the quote aligned with how the cabin will actually be used.

If the cabin will sit near a production line, also mention noise, heat, dust, and shift timing, because these affect insulation, ventilation, window placement, and the best door position for daily movement.

Frequently asked questions

Do you deliver porta cabins to Ludhiana and the Focal Point industrial area?
Yes. We manufacture at our Greater Noida factory and dispatch by road to Ludhiana city (141001), the Focal Point industrial estate (141010), and the Dhandari Kalan belt (141014). Transit is usually 3–4 days once the unit is built, with delivery charged at ₹3,000 where applicable.

What porta cabin sizes are available for Ludhiana sites?
Common sizes are 10×8 ft and 10×10 ft cabins, 20×8 ft site offices, and 40×8 ft project offices. We also build custom dimensions and double-decker units for packed Focal Point and Dhandari Kalan plots.

What does a porta cabin cost in Ludhiana?
Price depends on size, panel type, flooring, and add-ons like AC or a toilet. Since every unit is made to order, we confirm the final quote after a short requirement discussion so the figure matches your exact build.

Can the porta cabin be customised for factory, site, and security use?
Yes. We add AC, toilets, pantries, partitions, extra power points, and heavier flooring for gate or store use, and we match the layout, colour, and window and door count to your site.

Talk to the manufacturer. For porta cabins anywhere in the Ludhiana region, call our North zone team on +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or use Send Enquiry with your size and site details for a made-to-order quote.
